description: This file implements the DU Bearer Resource Manager for 5G NR, handling DRB setup, modification, removal, and context reestablishment, including validation and resource allocation logic.

classes.name: du_bearer_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages bearer resources including setup, modification, and removal of DRBs and SRBs for UEs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main method to update UE bearer resources, handling reestablishment, DRB removal, SRB setup, DRB setup, and modification.

methods.name: setup_srbs
methods.description: Sets up Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) for the UE based on the update request.

methods.name: setup_drbs
methods.description: Sets up Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) for the UE, including validation, LCID allocation, and configuration.

methods.name: modify_drbs
methods.description: Modifies existing DRBs as per the update request, with validation.

methods.name: rem_drbs
methods.description: Removes specified DRBs from the UE configuration.

methods.name: reestablish_context
methods.description: Reestablishes UE context during RRC reestablishment by copying SRB and DRB configurations.
